sun.title: The Sun
sun.text: Sunlight takes about 8 minutes to reach Earth. Never look straight at the real one!

moon.title: The Moon
moon.text: About 384,000 km away. Getting there is a mission for another day.

andromeda.title: Andromeda Galaxy
andromeda.text: About 2.5 million light-years away, and heading our way. There's about a 50-50 chance it crashes into our Milky Way in the next 10 billion years.

sources.title: NASA: Hubble Shows Milky Way is Destined for Head-On Collision
NASA: Hubble Casts Doubt on Certainty of Galactic Collision

milkyWay.title: The Milky Way
milkyWay.text: Our own galaxy. It's about 100,000 light-years across and holds 100 to 400 billion stars, and our Sun is one of them.

sources.title: NASA: How Big is Our Galaxy, the Milky Way?
NASA Space Place: What Is a Satellite Galaxy?

blackHole.title: Sagittarius A*
blackHole.text: The giant black hole at the center of our galaxy, with about 4 million times the Sun's mass. Nothing, not even light, can escape it. (This is an artist's idea of one.)

lmc.title: Large Magellanic Cloud
lmc.text: The biggest of the small 'satellite' galaxies that orbit our Milky Way. It's about 163,000 light-years away.

sources.title: NASA Space Place: What Is a Satellite Galaxy?

smc.title: Small Magellanic Cloud
smc.text: About 200,000 light-years away. It and the Large Cloud orbit each other and our Milky Way. From Earth's Southern Hemisphere, both look like faint glowing patches.

sources.title: NASA: Swift's Best-Ever UV View of the Nearest Galaxies
